newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish garment maker Elpo IPO undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish garment maker Elpo IPO undersubscribed.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 140,320 shares of 600,000-share Polish jeans garment maker Elpo SA initial public offering, the firm said in a statement on Friday.
It said the remaining 459,680 shares were alloted to the issue's underwriters.
It said Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA took 321,085 shares, Kredyt Bank 69,931, brokerage Krajowy Dom Maklerski Passa SA 32,696 shares and Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA 35,968 shares.
It said after the issue the firm's main shareholders are Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy holding a 42-percent stake and Kredyt Bank with 9.2 percent of shares.
The remaining shares are held by individuals.
